infoCollect.title: Information We Collect
items: Personal information, including your name, email address, profile picture, and institutional affiliation
Additional background information provided by instructors relevant to course management
Usage data such as login details, IP addresses, browser types, device information, pages visited, and features used
Course data, including assignments, grades, forum posts, and classwork scores
Communication content like messages in group chats and personal notes
Cookies and similar technologies to enhance functionality, personalize your experience, and analyze usage (you can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings)

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.content: We use your information to operate and improve the Service, personalize your experience, communicate with you, and ensure compliance with legal obligations.

howWeShare.title: How We Share Your Information
items: Third-party service providers under strict confidentiality agreements
Vercel for hosting and Service access (does not directly store user data)
Supabase for secure user data storage
Educational institutions for relevant course data when applicable
Group chat participants can see your name, profile picture, and messages
Notes remain private unless you choose to share them
Instructors can access student submissions and grades
Legal authorities when required by law or as part of business transfers when necessary

security.title: Security
security.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is entirely secure.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: Our Service is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us immediately.

choices.title: Your Choices & Data Deletion
choices.content: You can access, update, or correct your personal information in your account settings. You may also close your account, which will remove your data from the Service.

changes.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on the Service with an updated effective date.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us at <emailLink>scholaflow@gmail.com</emailLink> or <githubLink>open an issue on GitHub.</githubLink>
